text_block_list.text: The new year arrived—ushering in Agnes Digital's breakthrough year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year,
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
By the way, how was your year-end?
Did you manage to buy any good books?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. We haven't even known each other for a year yet,
so I won't pry too deeply.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure we can discuss it deeply
by this summer. Deal!?
I wasn't quite sure what was going on, but I nodded anyway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, it's about reflecting on last year and looking ahead to this year.
Standing on the dream stage, the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I was really getting way ahead of myself, wasn't I?!
Where did my beginner's mindset even go?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to get back to the basics once more.
This is what we must stick to this year!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
'Uma Musume are goddesses! Do not trespass!
Especially when it comes to racing!' ……is what they said.
choice_data_list: Are you worried about Meisho Doto?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Yes... No matter how I think about it,
I was being totally presumptuous, wasn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "I knew it! I should just accept the horse girls as they are! I'm gonna stan them no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Because that is my policy...

The delicate sense of distance before and after making one's debut.
Agnes Digital seemed to be struggling to grasp it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, while doing my best in races this year,
I plan on returning to my 'pure, righteous, and low-profile fangirling.'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Horse girls really are wonderful, aren't they?
First thing in the new year, let's reaffirm their charm~."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "How should I approach this? Do you have any recommendations for stan activities?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, service! That's right.
Now when everyone is resting is our big chance!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let us purify the sacred ground while we can.
Before "that Umamusume" makes her move!

As soon as she arrived at the training track,
Agnes Digital began diligently raking the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... Will this be enough?
I believe it should be much easier to run now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"May all the Umamusume
be able to run their best race."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Digital? What are you doing
in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-Scarlet-san...
No, I was just taking a little walk.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I'm glad. I thought someone had beaten me
to being the first arrival of the new year."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm off for a run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hai-ee~, take care!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm glad I made it in time. I knew
for sure you'd be coming right before the New Year's break ended.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This should let me run feeling great.
*Snap!*
Having anticipated Daiwa Scarlet's arrival, Agnes Digital successfully carried out her service.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Books... Let's see.
If we're talking about places with books about Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not from the library!
The book I was talking about is a different kind of book.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I have the most in my own room.
Well then, Trainer, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Now then, for New Year's, I'll take my time diving into all the books I've stockpiled...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, which one should I pick? Having a laugh
with a 4-koma Umamusume comic would be nice, or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No, isn't this a bit intense
for early in the year? It feels like it'll awaken some weird new fetish in me, so maybe something softer...
Afterward, Agnes Digital apparently relaxed in her room, leisurely reading some kind of book.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: An impression... Very well. Rather than just thinking it through, I shall commit my whole body to it. Here goes...!
With that said, Agnes Digital headed over to the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san,
please watch right there.
I'm going to show you the Seven Transformations of Digi-tan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: First up is—the Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next is Palmer-san's blazing breakaway! Besties!
Hurdle race! Wooooooo!

As expected of an Umamusume enthusiast, you're a sharp observer.
This movement could definitely be applied in an actual race.
